rationale: Common tabs, record cache/query/rendering improvements, calendar cell sizing and configurable 100ms/14-unit fade-slide transitions change JavaScript only. The reviewed production native fingerprint exactly reproduces the published v1.0.2 APK runtime. No dependency, lockfile, native module, plugin, permission, app configuration, build hook, package version or Android versionCode changed. The existing verified production publisher targets that installed APK runtime; no native release or version bump is needed. The deployment-only workflow/helper changes additionally build a matching web preview before OTA and promote it after verified Android publication; native inputs and runtime remain unchanged.
evidence: Published stable APK v1.0.2 candidate.json identifies source 710bd2e10b4eb8aa16378486f3cb3517770ac878, version 1.0.2, Android versionCode 3, production build d51d8be5-d5a1-4f8e-897e-71fd22381369, runtime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58. The helper verified its successful master Cloud Build run 40502268634; the tag/source is an ancestor of origin/master.

Reviewed the full published-APK-to-source file list and origin/master-to-source diff. Changes are src JavaScript/TypeScript, tests, Storybook configuration and the already-on-master download-page link. No Supabase migration/function changes are included.

package.json, package-lock.json, app.json, app.config.js, eas.json, modules, plugins and native build scripts are identical to the published APK source. App version remains 1.0.2 and Android versionCode remains 3.

Production nativeCompatibility reproduced normalizedRuntime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58 with compatible=true, no exemptions and no unexplained differences. This matches the APK embedded runtime exactly.

Reviewed check.yml, cloud-build.yml, publish-release.yml, publish-web.yml, deployment.mjs, deployment-review.mjs, deployment-history.mjs and release helpers. The current master already validates source digest, published APK baseline, deterministic deployment mode and exemptions before production publication.

The update publisher revalidates the published APK and native compatibility, applies the guarded private runtime override only to the checked production master child process, verifies the target runtime, and validates the returned Android EAS Update runtime and source commit. Native builds retain the fingerprint policy.

Cloud Build web now runs for apk and update modes, always checks out prepare.sha, exports web and uploads an immutable preview; its deployment output must exactly match the variant/source/run/attempt identifier. Update depends on both prepare and successful web.

Production update retains its environment approval and existing runtime checks. After Android publish succeeds, promote-web requires latest committed master, revalidates review/APK/native compatibility, checks the successful OTA source/runtime plus this run's exact preview identifier, and uses deploy:alias --prod for that immutable candidate. APK release promotion behavior is unchanged.

Deployment-only edits are limited to cloud-build.yml, deployment.mjs and deployment-history.mjs plus tests. No package scripts, native hooks, dependencies, permissions, plugins, identifiers or native configuration changed. The recomputed native fingerprint still exactly matches v1.0.2 with no exemptions.

Web promotion metadata is uploaded separately and retained in deployment-history. If web build fails OTA does not start; if Android publication fails web is not promoted. A later web promotion failure marks the job failed and retains the already-published OTA result; these two external services are not an atomic transaction.

Lint/typecheck, workflow YAML parsing and 198 tests passed, including wrong source/runtime/run/preview rejection and workflow ordering. Production web export passed for the unchanged app source in this release review.
